title: Kings of the Wyld
author: Nicholas Eames
summary: A once-famous band of mercenaries has long since gone their separate ways. When one of them asks for help to rescue his daughter from a besieged city, they get back together for one more dangerous job.
readIf: you like comic fantasy with an aging crew, old rivalries and a warm sense of friendship.
skipIf: you want a serious, slow epic, since this one is playful and sometimes crude.

pairings.reason: Another banter-filled fantasy about a close crew, with more scheming and a darker streak.
A classic, funny adventure that treats fantasy tropes with love and mischief.
The gentle origin of the fantasy company on a quest, with a quieter, more storybook feel.
